Markets.title: PB Fintech loses Rs 42,000 cr in 7 sessions, hits 32-month low
Markets.summary: Policybazaar parent PB Fintech lost over 48% of its market value, wiping out Rs 42,000 crore across seven sessions and hitting a 32-month low. The stock plummeted following an Irdai consultation paper proposing caps on distributor commissions.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks rise after US tech rally, oil dips
Markets.summary: Asian stocks edged up after major US technology companies helped drive the S&P 500 Index near an all-time high. Meanwhile, global oil prices dipped.

Markets.title: Banks cut CD borrowings by Rs 1.3 lakh crore in a month amid RBI liquidity boost
Markets.summary: Indian banks reduced their certificate of deposit borrowings by ₹1.3 lakh crore in a single month. This reduction occurred because a boost in liquidity from an RBI foreign currency deposit scheme lowered the demand for short-term funding and caused rates to fall.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: The Nifty rose 0.6% at the open, breaking an eight-week losing streak due to positive Q2 business updates and strong bank earnings. Meanwhile, the rupee depreciated against the US dollar amid rising oil prices and foreign capital outflows.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: Vedanta, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Marico, Axis Bank, Trent and Zydus Lifesciences
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets recovered on Monday following softer-than-expected US jobs data. Investors are currently monitoring corporate updates and operational performances from major companies like Vedanta and Kotak Mahindra Bank.

Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq gains 1% at close as investors focus on earnings
Markets.summary: Driven by strong performances from tech giants like Nvidia and Microsoft, the Nasdaq Composite reached an all-time high as investors anticipated robust S&P 500 earnings. Meanwhile, oil prices declined due to increased crude exports from the Middle East and support from the Group of Seven nations.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump stated that an unspecified "threat" prompted the U.S. military to withdraw its B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England. The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday that the aircraft have returned to their home bases in the United States.

Geo-Political.title: France braces for national day of school protests after injuries and mass arrests
Geo-Political.summary: France is preparing for a national day of protests supporting students who are demanding increased investment in education. This follows recent incidents involving injuries and mass arrests related to the ongoing demonstrations.

Geo-Political.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport or building, reports say
Geo-Political.summary: Reports indicate that a Flydubai co-pilot who was an Omani national and "lone wolf" extremist planned to crash a plane into a Tel Aviv airport or building. The authorities are treating the incident as a targeted terror threat involving aviation infrastructure.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky condemned a Russian missile strike on a Turkish-owned civilian ship carrying corn in the Black Sea. The attack killed the vessel's captain and injured or forced the rescue of 11 crew members.

Geo-Political.title: Spain PM pins hopes on housing crisis to help win snap election
Geo-Political.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez calculatedly called a snap election after assessing the political landscape. He is relying heavily on the ongoing housing crisis to secure a victory in the upcoming vote.

Geo-Political.title: US 'watching closely' after plague researcher dies in Russia
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump stated that the United States is closely monitoring the death of a laboratory technician at a Siberian research center. The technician died following an incident at the Russian facility that previously researched deadly diseases like the plague.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This traffic was generated without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape of 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide details the top ten AI tools designed to streamline and revolutionize the content creation process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI platform that allows users to generate, share, and monetize various types of digital content. The service offers a fresh approach to content creation within the rapidly growing generative AI market.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and improve workplace efficiency. These widely used market solutions cater to various industry applications, including natural language processing.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article lists the top ten AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right AI tool to create efficient, engaging, and relevant content for their audience.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative options for users.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled for Thursday, says official order
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting in New Delhi has been rescheduled to Thursday. The discussion will focus on process reforms and compliance simplification instead of rate changes.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting postponed for second time, rescheduled to October 8
Data & Insights.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting has been postponed for a second time to October 8. The meeting will focus on discussing changes regarding GST registration, returns, and refund mechanisms.

Data & Insights.title: China’s banking shake-up: 670 lenders vanish as Beijing moves to contain financial risks
Data & Insights.summary: China shut down a record 670 banks in 2025 to consolidate weaker rural lenders. This shake-up aims to contain rising bad loans and manage slower economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: India’s growth momentum holds, but inflation and weak industrial activity weigh, says BCG report
Data & Insights.summary: A BCG report shows India's economic growth is continuing, driven by strong investment and services. However, rising inflation and weak manufacturing and consumer sentiment are weighing on the expansion.

Data & Insights.title: Mint explainer: how Brics’ new tax platforms could change cross-border taxation
Data & Insights.summary: BRICS is developing new platforms focused on international taxation, transfer pricing, and revenue data. This initiative aims to give emerging economies greater influence over global cross-border tax rules.

Data & Insights.title: Rate hikes are coming, but don’t count credit growth out just yet
Data & Insights.summary: India's upcoming interest rate hikes are unlikely to immediately halt the current credit upcycle. Strong economic growth, ample liquidity, and structural demand will help sustain credit expansion in the short term.

India.title: Woman, 26, Jumps Into Well With 4-Year-Old Son In UP, Both Die: Cops
India.summary: A 26-year-old woman and her four-year-old son died after jumping into a well in Uttar Pradesh on Monday. Police have recovered both bodies, and the reason for the incident remains unknown.

India.title: Delhi Cop Vivek Bhagat's Promotion Withheld Amid Sexual Harassment Allegation
India.summary: Delhi police officer Vivek Bhagat's promotion has been withheld following sexual harassment allegations against him. The government stated that the initial proposal and approval for his additional duty charge occurred before these events unfolded.

India.title: "Girls Don't Marry Village Boys": Farmer's 'Brides' Request To DK Shivakumar
India.summary: A farmer told Chief Minister DK Shivakumar that men in farming communities are struggling to find brides despite owning agricultural land. He highlighted that women are increasingly reluctant to marry men who live in villages.

India.title: Top Court Tells Delhi Police To Make Women Safe, Even At 11 pm
India.summary: India's Supreme Court directed the Delhi Police to ensure women feel safe while traveling on roads or the metro late at night. Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran emphasized that safety must be guaranteed even at 11 pm.

India.title: Bengaluru Jail Official Arrested For Allegedly Soliciting Sex From Convict's Wife
India.summary: A Bengaluru jail official, Sri Somashekar, has been arrested for allegedly soliciting sex from a convict's wife. The allegation came to light during a police investigation into the 2018 release of convict Shankar A. using a forged Supreme Court order.

India.title: Bengaluru Gym Trainer Killed After Argument Inside Client's Apartment
India.summary: A Bengaluru gym trainer was killed following an argument inside a client's apartment. Police stated that the suspects include three of the victim's gym colleagues and a client whom they all trained.

General.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
General.summary: President Trump stated that an unspecified "threat" caused the U.S. to withdraw B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England. The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday that these aircraft were returned to their home stations in the United States.

General.title: What prompted the US bombers to leave RAF Fairford?
General.summary: American bombers evacuated from RAF Fairford due to concerns held within the Pentagon. The mass departure highlights the serious nature of these security concerns.

General.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
General.summary: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer has died at the age of 86. His final book, Adam and Eve, is scheduled for release this month.

General.title: King's funding for Andrew not to be used for legal action against police
General.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor is taking legal action regarding search warrants issued before his February arrest. King Charles's funding will not be used to cover the costs of this specific police challenge.

General.title: France braces for national day of school protests after injuries and mass arrests
General.summary: France is preparing for a national day of school protests following recent student demonstrations over education funding that resulted in injuries and mass arrests. Students have been demanding increased investment in the French education system.

General.title: Tories pledge £10bn 'Britannia Shield' air defence system
General.summary: The Conservative party has pledged a £10 billion air defence system called the "Britannia Shield" to protect the UK. The proposal comes in response to warnings from NATO allies about Russian drone incursions.
